entries.text: YOU DID IT![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1290_rival_02

entries.text: It...it’s not going berserk anymore?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1290_botan_02

entries.text: How...\c\nHow very astounding![VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_23a

entries.text: How...\c\nHow very astounding![VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_23b

entries.text: To think that you would manage to defy even\nthe original professor’s final protections![VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_24a

entries.text: To think that you would manage to defy even\nthe original professor’s final protections![VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_24b

entries.text: Are you back to normal?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1290_friend_05

entries.text: Yes... A completely unforeseen outcome, even\nfor an AI possessing the most sophisticated\r\ntechnology ever conceived.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_25a

entries.text: Yes... A completely unforeseen outcome, even\nfor an AI possessing the most sophisticated\r\ntechnology ever conceived.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_25b

entries.text:
Even on the brink of despair, you children did
not give in and instead proved your worthiness:
showing the wisdom to think for yourselves,
the courage to hold faith in your friends,
and the fortitude to do what had to be done.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_26a

entries.text: No matter how difficult your own pasts may\nhave been...[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_27a

entries.text: No matter how challenging of a future may\nawait you...[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_27b

entries.text: I believe you will be capable of walking whatever\npaths you choose for yourselves now. With pride.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_28a

entries.text: I believe you will be capable of walking whatever\npaths you choose for yourselves now. With pride.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_28b

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I thank you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. I thank
all
of
you children.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_01a

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I thank you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. I thank
all
of
you children.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_01b

entries.text:
But I am afraid that the time machine cannot be
put to a complete stop so long as I am here.\c
It appears I myself am part of the system that
ensures the machine reboots when stopped.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_02a

entries.text: Huh? Wh-what does that mean?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1290_friend_01

entries.text: I am sorry.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_03a

entries.text: I am sorry.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_03b

entries.text: You know, when I was watching you all on your\nadventures from down here, I felt a sense of...\r\njealousy.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_04a

entries.text: You know, when I was watching you all on your\nadventures from down here, I felt a sense of...\r\njealousy.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_04b

entries.text: I envied you your freedom.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_05a

entries.text: I envied you your freedom.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_05b

entries.text: The way that you came together, working in\nleague with your fellows and caring for them...[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_06a

entries.text: The way that you came together, working in\nleague with your fellows and caring for them...[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_06b

entries.text: The way that you sought strength and to better\nyourself, throwing all you are into your battles...[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_07a

entries.text: The way that you sought strength and to better\nyourself, throwing all you are into your battles...[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_07b

entries.text: The way that you would face down even the\ngreatest enemies to save that which you loved...[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_08a

entries.text: The way that you would face down even the\ngreatest enemies to save that which you loved...[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_08b

entries.text: The way that you never ceased to seek—nor to\nfight for—a treasure all your own...[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_09a

entries.text: The way that you never ceased to seek—nor to\nfight for—a treasure all your own...[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_09b

entries.text: Agi gi!
entries.label: common_1290_legend_01

entries.text: Ah, and the way that you soared free through\nthe very skies on those wings of yours.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_10a

entries.text: Ah, and the way that you soared free through\nthe very skies on those wings of yours.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_10b

entries.text: I wish that I, too, might be as free as you all—\nfree to seek out that which I might treasure\r\nabove all else. Not...bound.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_11a

entries.text: I wish that I, too, might be as free as you all—\nfree to seek out that which I might treasure\r\nabove all else. Not...bound.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_11b

entries.text: Your own treasure...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1290_botan_01

entries.text: As long as I remain here, the time machine will\nnot stop—for I am inextricably connected to it.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_12a

entries.text: As long as I remain here, the time machine will\nnot stop—for I am inextricably connected to it.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_12b

entries.text: So I’ve made a decision.\c\nI will use the time machine to journey to the\nworld of the ancient past that I have dreamed of.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_13a

entries.text: So I’ve made a decision.\c\nI will use the time machine to journey to the\nworld of the future that I have dreamed of.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_13b

entries.text: What?! You can’t just leave now—right when we\nfinally reached you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1290_rival_01

entries.text: I am not going only so that the time machine can\nbe stopped.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_14a

entries.text: I am not going only so that the time machine can\nbe stopped.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_14b

entries.text: I also cannot deny my desire to see that ancient\nworld for myself.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_15a

entries.text: I also cannot deny my desire to see that future\nworld for myself.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_15b

entries.text: Is this what it feels like to have your heart race\nwith the thrill of adventure...?[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_16a

entries.text: Is this what it feels like to have your heart race\nwith the thrill of adventure...?[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_16b

entries.text: Arven. I am sorry that I kept the truth from you\nfor so long.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_18a

entries.text: Arven. I am sorry that I kept the truth from you\nfor so long.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_18b

entries.text: I inherited all the thoughts and wishes of the\nprofessor, and so I understand better than any...[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_19a

entries.text: I inherited all the thoughts and wishes of the\nprofessor, and so I understand better than any...[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_19b

entries.text: Your mother truly loved you.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_20a

entries.text: Your father truly loved you.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_20b

entries.text: You...you can’t...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1290_friend_02

entries.text: You can’t just go and say a thing like that now![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1290_friend_03

entries.text: No? I suppose you’re right. I am sorry.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_21a

entries.text: No? I suppose you’re right. I am sorry.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
entries.label: common_1290_hakase_21b
